csv_project_name: Developer For Boston Neck Rd - Housing Development
csv_scope_of_work: The purpose of this Request for Proposals ("RFP") is to solicit proposals for the development and potential disposition of vacant land owned by the Town of Narragansett ( Town ). This land, which is comprised of two abutting properties, is located on Boston Neck Road, Narragansett, Rhode Island, Assessors Plat N-L, Lot 22 and Plat N-O, Lot 5 ( Property ) and is 2.61 acres in size combined. The Town seeks the development of a number of affordable housing residential units with off-street parking. These units can either be year-round rental properties, provide homeownership opportunities, or a combination of the two. Proposals will be reviewed by Town Staff and that which best addresses the Towns need will be recommended for approval by the Narragansett Town Council.
